## Apricot Bow

Apricot Bow is a *fan-indexed name* for a peach-colored Earth-pony mare glimpsed during the search for Applejack in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. She's easiest to recognize as the western-hatted background pony Twilight approaches with Applejack's picture in **“The Last Roundup” (S2E14)**.

- **Appearance:** Light apricot coat, coral-pink mane and tail, a western-style hat, and a cutie mark of three blue shapes interpreted as bows or wrapped candies. She reuses a character design also seen on Sweetie Drops/Bon Bon and other background mares; that does **not** establish a secret identity. [Background-pony catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares).
- **Name and voice:** “Apricot Bow” is a fandom/wiki identification, not a verified name spoken in the episode or established by official merchandise. No dialogue or credited voice actor has been verified for her. [Cutie-mark index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_cutie_marks).
- **Appearances:** The confirmed G4 television appearance is *The Last Roundup* (season 2, episode 14). Similar-looking ponies elsewhere, including in comics, cannot confidently be identified as this same individual.

## Important moments

1. **Twilight's search reaches a bystander — “The Last Roundup” (S2E14).** At the Dodge Junction train station, Twilight shows the mare Applejack's picture while looking for her missing friend. It's her one identifiable scene, not a speaking or plot-changing role. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oYMRUKA0610) (*scene timestamp unavailable; not independently verified*).

Only one identifiable scene could be verified; adding further “important moments” would misattribute other characters' actions.
